fixtureProvenance: Synthetic wire records in scripts/verify-pulls.ts follow the retained Gitea 1.23.4 Swagger schemas; they are not vendor observations.
coverageBoundary: Operation IDs include supporting reads and deliberately unresolved capabilities; this is not a claim that all associated acceptance outcomes or vendor semantics are commissioned.

review.reason: The retained ReviewStateType lacks exact event values and commit_id does not establish atomic stale-head refusal.
review.behavior: Validate exactly one action, then refuse before any HTTP request or review post, including with --match-head-commit.

merge.protocol: Require an explicit checked head SHA and transmit head_commit_id; the fake refuses a head changed after preflight.
merge.verification: Read PR identity, merged state, base tip and final merge/squash/rebase topology; rebase additionally compares original commit messages.
merge.pending: Live vendor atomicity, content equivalence and commissioning. Auto, admin and branch deletion semantics remain independently gated.

artium: Opt-in; exact frozen revision, manifest digest, candidate head and package digest are recorded in each external journey report. A standalone pass explicitly skips hosted proof.
